methods.GDPAdmissionThresholds: Exactly source2,one complete response page,unique expected ISO3/year/indicator identities,finite strictly positive native values,all2010-2024 years. Null or absent cells retained as missing. No rounding,interpolation,partial EU sum or currency conversion.
methods.regionalAdmission: Seven original accounts and joint population/GDP/primary-energy/fossil-industrial-CO2 territorial/year/vintage/bunker compatibility required. A GDP-only sidecar or complete five accounts is insufficient.
methods.monthlyDailyAdmission: Require verified source identity,rights,original release version,publisher URL/date,exact source/method SHA256,gas CO2,mass per calendar period,explicit sector/region scope,observation cutoff and monthly/daily frequency. Exact complete calendar month or single-day rows only; reject CO2e,annual-mean daily rates,quarterly power,projections,duplicates,nonfinite values and empty report evidence. Revised history explicitly permitted only as revised history,never certified historical-origin availability.
methods.forecastAuthorization: No fit or holdout execution unless original full contract admitted. Both original and separately versioned alternative contracts fail; no forecast or score was run.

newPrimaryGDPAssembly.worldIdentityResolution: Frozen CSV World has blank iso_code. WDI WLD is mapped to the exact frozen country label World only,not to arbitrary blank-ISO aggregates; an explicit collision test enforces this.
newPrimaryGDPAssembly.originalMPDMissingDefinition: All27 EU members in2023/2024,both native gdppc and native population absent. This2021PPP sidecar fills NONE of those2011PPP cells.
newPrimaryGDPAssembly.GDPRatioMeaning: Unlike PPP reference years,native GDP source methods and release vintages. Numeric ratios/differences retained solely as incompatibility evidence,not a deflator,GSAT factor,validation residual or allowed substitution.
newPrimaryGDPAssembly.populationDecision: New native population is not source-identical to frozen population; preserve differences,no offset or reweighting. Country/territory and revision differences need source-specific reconciliation.
